integrity: The integral homotopy theorem is proved by an explicit acyclic Morse matching and a root-graph fundamental-group retraction; finite exhaustive checks are supporting reproducibility, not the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Parameter one, finite simple graphs as one-dimensional simplicial complexes; no higher tolerance, filled flag triangles, or equivariant result. General novelty beyond indexed literature and published-finding corpus is not independently certified.
title: The homotopy type of one-tolerance complexes of arbitrary graphs
